newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes up as mkt awaits govt econ plans.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes up as mkt awaits govt econ plans.

text.p: The Czech PX50 was in bullish mood on Wednesday ahead of an expected government announcement of a package of economic measures to stimulate the economy and bring new confidence to the markets.
Before the anticipated announcement, sentiment was generally optimistic pushing the PX50's most heavily weighted shares sharply higher.
"There is quite a lot of speculation on the market...I think this probably shows (the market thinks) there are more positive things being discussed," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
The PX50 closed up 7.0 points, or 1.29 percent, to 551.0.
SPT Telecom, the most heavily weighted share accounting for more than 20 percent of the PX50's capitalisation, surged 103 crowns to 3,483.
Komercni Banka the biggest banking issue also posted strong gains, rising 94 crowns to 2,299.
